scenes.line1: Is TDD always the best choice?
scenes.say: Is test-driven development always the best way to build software? Where does it fall short?
Here’s the TDD cycle: First, write a failing test. Next, make it pass with minimal code. Finally, refactor for clarity and maintainability.

scenes.label: Drawbacks
scenes.sub: TDD struggles with UIs or complex integrations.
scenes.say: But TDD isn’t perfect. It works best for logic-heavy code and struggles with user interfaces or complex integrations.

scenes.question: Is TDD ideal for all code?
scenes.right: No, adapt your approach for UI or integration-heavy features.
scenes.say: Don’t fall for this trap: TDD isn’t ideal for every situation. Adapt your approach for UI or integration-heavy features.
